title: Turkey's Defence Ministry Condemns Houthi Drone Attack on Saudi Arabia
detail: Turkey's defence ministry publicly condemned a Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia, signaling Turkish alignment with the Saudi-led coalition's position on Houthi aggression. The statement comes amid escalating Saudi offensive planning and signals growing cohesion among Mecca Pact members in their response to Houthi strikes.

title: Pakistan Sends Four Planeloads of Weapons to Saudi-Backed Yemeni Government
detail: Pakistan dispatched four planeloads of weapons to the Saudi-backed Yemeni government, marking a significant deepening of Pakistani military support for the anti-Houthi coalition. The arms transfer signals Pakistan's growing operational commitment within the Mecca Pact framework as coalition members escalate pressure on Houthi forces.

media.caption: Pakistan arms transfer to Saudi-backed Yemeni government deepens anti-Houthi coalition support

title: US Sends Additional Patriot Missile Defense Batteries to Saudi Arabia and Qatar
detail: The United States is deploying additional Patriot missile defense batteries to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to bolster Gulf air defenses as Houthi cross-border attacks persist. The reinforcement underscores US commitment to protecting key Gulf partners and complements existing Mecca Pact security arrangements amid the ongoing Houthi threat.

media.caption: Patriot missile defense batteries being deployed to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to counter Houthi strikes
